description: Area charts from one spec: stacked piles the channels, stackOffset wiggle and silhouette turn the pile into a streamgraph on a centred baseline, stacked100 normalises each month to a share, stack groups two independent piles on one chart so their totals can be compared, gradient fades each fill towards the baseline, and a range area draws the band between lowValues and values with the mean as a line over it. Free, in @svgrid/grid.

faq.question: How do I draw a streamgraph?
faq.answer: Set stacked: true and stackOffset: wiggle (or silhouette) on the spec. The pile is centred on its own baseline instead of sitting on zero; hide the value axis labels, since the offsets have no zero.

faq.question: How do I draw a band between a low and a high?
faq.answer: Use type range-area with values as the high end and lowValues as the low end. Add a line series over it for the mean.

faq.question: Can two stacks share one chart?
faq.answer: Yes. Give each series a stack name; series with the same name pile on each other, and each pile is drawn from the baseline on its own.
